description: Produces developer integration recipes for the Learnosity Author API and item bank (Data API). Given a natural-language description of an authoring-integration task — 'embed the Learnosity item editor for this user', 'save this item to my item bank', 'list items tagged X' — L0177 verifies the canonical request construction and its get_spec output is a precise, host-language-neutral recipe: goal, preconditions, procedure (with the exact signature preimage), gotchas, and acceptance criteria. It does NOT author item content (that is L0176) and does NOT emit runnable code; it tells the developer exactly what to do and how to know they are done.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I embed the Learnosity item editor in my LMS for user u123 on domain lms.acme.edu, allowing MCQ and cloze widgets?
example_prompts.notes: Names the operation (editor embed), the end-user identity, the serving domain (which must match the signing domain), and the allowed widget types — everything the Author API init request needs.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I save an authored item into my Learnosity item bank with my own consumer key and secret?
example_prompts.notes: Item bank writes go through the Data API and require the caller's own credentials; the recipe covers signing and the /itembank/items request.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I list items in my Learnosity item bank filtered by a standards tag?
example_prompts.notes: A Data API read; the recipe covers the request envelope, pagination, and the meta.status success check.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I tag existing item bank items with a Common Core standard so the Author Site can filter on them?
example_prompts.notes: Item metadata/tags via the Data API; the recipe explains item-level vs question-level tags and how the Author Site indexes them.
